UI_options_FSR_UPSC_Upscaler_desc: AMD FidelityFX upscaling for the world pass only; UI/text stays full-res. fsr2/fsr3 run as real GL compute passes (fsr1 rescue on compute fault).
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_QualityTitle_desc: FidelityFX presets: Ultra Quality 0.78x, Quality 0.69x, Balanced 0.60x, Performance 0.50x, native 1.0.
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_Sharp_desc: FidelityFX RCAS edge-adaptive sharpening after the upscale. Higher = sharper, can ring.
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_FgTest_desc: Experimental software frame generation: one inserted present per real frame. Requires VSync ON (the in-game FPS counter reading ~half is expected). Inserted frame's UI is one frame old. See the mod README for details.
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_PaceTitle_desc: Exposure pacing when frame generation is used with VSync OFF. Keep off while using VSync ON (combining both drops the loop to a few fps). Auto values derive from the display mode's frequency.
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_PaceSafe: Safe (1 refresh exposure, loop = display/2, tear-free)
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_PaceFast: Fast (half refresh exposure, loop ~= display, can tear)
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_RestartRequired: Mode (fsr1/fsr2/fsr3) changes apply at next launch; frame generation applies immediately.
UI_options_FSR_UPSC_Note: World pass only. UI stays full-res.
